articles.title: French bond selloff eases as country spared ratings downgrade
articles.excerpt:
On Monday, the selloff in French government bonds paused after Moody's maintained its rating of Aa3. Weekend protests were mostly peaceful, reducing tensions in the country. Analysts expect the ECB to monitor the rising yields closely and evaluate their impact.
